test_title: PYST 52: SSC CPO - English Comprehension (Held on 04 Oct, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Demolish
solution:
The **correct answer **is **Option **4 i.e. **Fabricate**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given word, "**Demolish**", means to completely destroy a building, structure, or idea. 

 
 
• **Example**: The old building was scheduled to be demolished to make way for a new shopping center.
 
 
 
• The correct option, "**Fabricate**", means to create or manufacture something. 
 
 
• **Example**: The company fabricates automotive parts for major car manufacturers.
 
 

Therefore, the **correct answer **is- **Fabricate**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Option 1, "**Inferior**", means lower in rank, status, or quality.

 
 
• **Example**: The product was of inferior quality and did not last long.
 
 
 
• Option 2, "**Annihilate**", means to destroy utterly; obliterate.
 
 
• **Example**: The invading army's goal was to annihilate the enemy forces completely.
 
 
 
• Option 3, "**Unmethodical**", means not using a systematic or organized method.
 
 
• **Example**: His unmethodical approach to studying made it difficult for him to retain information.
